lines.en: Kirin immediately invites me over after I give her a call to see what she's up to.
lines.zh: 我打电话问 Kirin 在忙什么，她立刻邀我过去。

lines.en: I don't find out until I get there that she bailed on going to some get-together with the soccer team to see me...and I can't tell exactly how that makes me feel right off the bat.
lines.zh: 直到我到了才知道，她为了见我，推掉了和足球队的一场聚会……而我一时说不清这让我是什么感受。

lines.en: On one hand, a cute girl wants to spend time with me and prioritized me over a bunch of people she's known for much longer. Awesome.
lines.zh: 一方面，一个可爱的女孩想和我待在一起，还把我排在了一群她认识更久的人前面。很棒。

lines.en: But, on the other hand, it confuses me a bit as to why she's so readily let those people down in exchange for something she didn't even know was happening until half an hour ago.
lines.zh: 但另一方面，我有点困惑：她为什么能这么轻易地让那些人失望，只为了换一个半小时前她才知道会发生的事。

lines.en: The two of us aren't exactly close.
Sure, I like being around her, but virtually everything she does confuses the fuck out of me.
lines.zh: 当然，我喜欢和她待在一起，但她做的几乎每一件事都把我搞得一头雾水。

lines.en: And it's not like she's the kind of person who will tell me what it all means either so I guess I'll just...
lines.zh: 而且她也不是那种会告诉我这一切意味着什么的人，所以我想我就……

lines.en: Keep waiting to see what happens.
lines.zh: 继续等着看会发生什么吧。

lines.en: The two of us spend the afternoon on her couch.
lines.zh: 我们俩在她家的沙发上度过了一个下午。

lines.en: We start off on different sides, but she slowly moves her way over to me and rests her head on my shoulder.
lines.zh: 一开始我们各坐一头，但她慢慢挪了过来，把头靠在我肩上。

lines.en: It's not often that she does cute things like that, so I take in the moment and hope that whatever caused her to do it today was more than just {i}being bored{/i} or whatever she always says.
lines.zh: 她不常做这么可爱的事，所以我好好享受了这一刻，也希望她今天这么做的原因不只是{i}无聊{/i}，或者她总挂在嘴边的那些理由。
